mathematical_definition: finite polynomial; fixed 2-jet if calibrated
large_deformation: unbounded on an unbounded domain when positive
proof_or_condition: admit only if nonnegative and elliptic on D; alone does not encode a finite boundary

mathematical_definition: finite invariant polynomial or polynomial in strain coordinates
large_deformation: usually unbounded; may be noncoercive by direction
proof_or_condition: admit members passing lower-bound and ellipticity tests; reject members with bad rays

mathematical_definition: convergent invariant series, including entire functions
large_deformation: coercive, bounded, or singular according to full series
proof_or_condition: representation only; reference coefficients through order two are fixed

mathematical_definition: exp of an invariant scalar, sums/compositions
large_deformation: normally unbounded; directional behavior depends on its argument
proof_or_condition: admit only normalized, stationary, stable members; not equivalent to its finite Taylor truncation

mathematical_definition: log of a positive invariant/spectral expression
large_deformation: finite, coercive, or barrier depending on argument
regularity: smooth only where argument is positive
proof_or_condition: admit only with domain containing I and complete boundary control

mathematical_definition: real powers of positive invariants or stretches
large_deformation: power-dependent; may grow, decay, or blow up
proof_or_condition: noninteger powers require a declared branch; bad growth members rejected

mathematical_definition: ratio of invariant polynomials
large_deformation: may saturate, grow, or have poles
proof_or_condition: poles must coincide with excluded boundary; interior poles reject

mathematical_definition: trigonometric, hyperbolic, inverse, or other smooth composition
large_deformation: function-dependent
proof_or_condition: no new class at the constraint level; audit as a smooth scalar function

mathematical_definition: sum_A f(lambda_A) or symmetric stretch expression
large_deformation: controlled by f at spectral endpoints
proof_or_condition: admissible iff symmetric and spectrally regular; equivalent to an invariant representation

mathematical_definition: symmetric w(lambda1,lambda2,lambda3)
large_deformation: arbitrary admissible endpoint profile
regularity: C2 symmetric w with collision compatibility
proof_or_condition: most general spectral coordinate form; equivalent to Phi(I1,I2,I3)

mathematical_definition: f(J)+g(invariants of J^(-2/3)C), plus allowed couplings
large_deformation: component-dependent
proof_or_condition: coordinate decomposition, not a new functional class; uncoupled restriction is not required

mathematical_definition: nonseparable Phi(I1,I2,I3)
large_deformation: arbitrary admissible endpoint profile
proof_or_condition: generic surviving representation

mathematical_definition: Phi approaches +infinity at every forbidden boundary
large_deformation: asymptotic barrier; unbounded energy; finite extensibility
regularity: C1 interior, C2 near I; singular only at boundary
proof_or_condition: directly enforces the frozen finite capacity

mathematical_definition: finite interior Phi and +infinity outside closed D
large_deformation: finite or unbounded interior; hard finite extensibility
regularity: lower semicontinuous globally, smooth operational interior
proof_or_condition: enforces the frozen state constraint without an interior blow-up

mathematical_definition: regular one-sided endpoint with separately declared frozen D
large_deformation: may be bounded/saturating
proof_or_condition: admissible only because the independent state constraint forbids continuation

mathematical_definition: Phi tends to a finite plateau on an extendible domain
large_deformation: bounded energy; often vanishing tangent
proof_or_condition: does not enforce finite capacity and may lose restoring/elliptic response

mathematical_definition: Phi -> +infinity as norm(C)+norm(C^-1)->infinity
large_deformation: coercive and unbounded
proof_or_condition: sufficient confinement only if D is unbounded; frozen finite-bound branch still needs an endpoint implementation

mathematical_definition: two or more minima or nonconvex sectors
large_deformation: arbitrary
proof_or_condition: not forbidden by FP-4, but unique recovery is not natural; retain only a stable elliptic branch containing I

mathematical_definition: piecewise smooth invariant scalar
large_deformation: arbitrary
proof_or_condition: joins in propagation domain must preserve classical stress/tangent; nonsmooth I is rejected

mathematical_definition: energy defined by minimization, supremum, or envelope
large_deformation: arbitrary
proof_or_condition: admissible only where a unique smooth envelope supplies the required classical response; no hidden state
